units.literal: Thereupon General of Agile Cavalry Wang Dao, Chamberlain for Ceremonials He Xun, Attendant Ji Zhan, Palace Writer Gentleman Yu Liang, Great General's Advisory Army Consultant Mei Tao, Cavalier Gentleman Zhang Yi, and others deliberated, saying: "The canon of corporal punishments has long been honored in origin.

units.zh: 肇自古先，以及三代，聖哲明王所未曾改也。
units.en: Three-age kings kept mutilation.
units.literal: From earliest ancestors through three dynasties sagely enlightened kings never altered them.

units.zh: 豈是漢文常主所能易者乎！
units.en: Han Wendi was no sage legislator.
units.literal: How could mere Emperor Wen of Han alter them!

units.zh: 時蕭曹已沒，絳灌之徒不能正其義。
units.en: By then Xiao He and Cao Shen were dead, and men like Zhou Bo and Guan Ying could not set the principle right.
units.literal: At that time Xiao He and Cao Shen had already died, and men like Zhou Bo and Guan Ying could not set the principle right.

units.zh: 逮班固深論其事，以為外有輕刑之名，內實殺人。
units.en: Ban Gu exposed Wen’s reform as bloodier.
units.literal: When Ban Gu examined deeply he judged outwardly lighter punishments inwardly killed more.

units.zh: 又死刑太重，生刑太輕，生刑縱於上，死刑怨於下，輕重失當，故刑政不中也。
units.en: Wen’s imbalance caused penal dysfunction.
units.literal: Further capital death weighs too heavy while living punishments weigh too light—living lax above, capital bitter below—imbalance misorders punishments.

units.zh: 且原先王之造刑也，非以過怒也，非以殘人也，所以救奸，所以當罪。
units.en: Classical mutilation targeted rehabilitation.
units.literal: Moreover former kings crafting punishments acted not from excess anger nor desire to maim but to rescue society and match guilt.

units.zh: 今盜者竊人之財，淫者好人之色，亡者避叛之役，皆無殺害也，則加之以刑。
units.en: Thieves, illicit-sex offenders, and fugitives have killed no one and should therefore receive corporal rather than capital punishment.
units.literal: Now thieves steal lust seduces fugitives flee corvée—none kills yet punishments apply.

units.zh: 刑之則止，而加之斬戮，戮過其罪，死不可生，縱虐於此，歲以巨計。
units.en: Death sentences overshot proportion annually.
units.literal: Punishment should stop yet waist-cutting adds killing—execution exceeds guilt—death cannot revive—such cruelty yearly tallies vast.

units.zh: 此乃仁人君子所不忍聞，而況行之於政乎！
units.en: Mass execution horrifies humane ears.
units.literal: This benevolent gentlemen cannot bear hearing—how execute policy!

units.zh: 若乃惑其名而不練其實，惡其生而趣其死，此畏水投舟，避坎蹈井，愚夫之不若，何取於政哉！
units.en: Rejecting mutilation for killing is suicidal stupidity.
units.literal: If deluded by reputation ignoring substance hating life rushing death—that fears water yet boards boat avoids pit yet leaps well—fools exceed such conduct—what governance values that!

units.zh: 今大晉中興，遵復古典，率由舊章，起千載之滯義，拯百殘之遺黎，使皇典廢而復存，黔首死而更生，至義暢於三代之際，遺風播乎百世之後，生肉枯骨，惠侔造化，豈不休哉！
units.en: Now in the Great Jin Restoration, the dynasty follows and restores the ancient canons and is guided by the old regulations. It raises up a meaning stalled for a thousand years, rescues the surviving people from a hundred ruins, makes the imperial canon exist again after being abolished, and makes the common people live again after death. Utmost righteousness will flourish in the age of the Three Dynasties, and its remaining influence will spread after a hundred generations. To make flesh grow on dry bones and make kindness equal to creation: is this not excellent!

Utmost righteousness will flourish in the age of the Three Dynasties, and its remaining influence will spread after a hundred generations. To make flesh grow on dry bones and make kindness equal to creation: is this not excellent!

units.zh: 惑者乃曰，死猶不懲，而況于刑？
units.en: Skeptics ask whether mutilation deters.
units.literal: Critics say death still fails to deter—how much less mutilation?

units.zh: 然人者冥也，其至愚矣，雖加斬戮，忽為灰土，死事日往，生欲日存，未以為改。
units.en: Death’s abstraction fails deterrence.
units.literal: Yet humans are benighted—most foolish—even executions vanish them to ash daily death dulls desire—few reform.

units.zh: 若刑諸市朝，朝夕鑒戒，刑者詠為惡之永痛，惡者睹殘刖之長廢，故足懼也。
units.en: Public mutilation educates better than hidden execution.
units.literal: If executing in marketplace morning and evening offers mirror—criminals chant wicked pain forever villains glimpse lifelong maiming—then awe suffices.

units.zh: 然後知先王之輕刑以禦物，顯誡以懲愚，其理遠矣。」
units.en: Only then do we know that the former kings used light punishments to govern things and visible admonitions to discipline the foolish; their principle was far-reaching."
units.literal: Only then do we know that the former kings used light punishments to govern things and visible admonitions to discipline the foolish; their principle was far-reaching."

units.zh: 尚書令刁協、尚書薛兼等議，以為：「聖上悼殘荒之遺黎，傷犯死之繁眾，欲行刖以代死刑，使犯死之徒得存性命，則率土蒙更生之澤，兆庶必懷恩以反化也。
units.en: Secretariat Director Diao Xie, Secretary Xue Jian, and others deliberated, saying: "The Sagely One above grieves for the surviving people left from ruin and desolation and is pained by the great number who commit capital crimes. He wishes to use amputation to replace the death penalty, so that those who have committed capital crimes may preserve their lives. Then all within the land will receive the grace of renewed life, and the multitude will surely cherish kindness and return to transformation.
units.literal: Secretariat Director Diao Xie, Secretary Xue Jian, and others deliberated, saying: "The Sagely One above grieves for the surviving people left from ruin and desolation and is pained by the great number who commit capital crimes. He wishes to use amputation to replace the death penalty, so that those who have committed capital crimes may preserve their lives. Then all within the land will receive the grace of renewed life, and the multitude will surely cherish kindness and return to transformation.

units.zh: 今中興祚隆，大命惟新，誠宜設寬法以育人。
units.en: Restoration warrants humane statutes.
units.literal: Now restored mandate flourishes great mandate anew—fitting to erect lenient law nurturing people.

units.zh: 然懼群小愚蔽，習玩所見而忽異聞，或未能咸服。
units.en: Mass education precedes reform.
units.literal: Yet fear petty men foolish blind familiar sights ignoring strange reports—not all persuaded.

units.zh: 愚謂行刑之時，先明申法令，樂刑者刖，甘死者殺，則心必服矣。
units.en: Offer convicts death-vs-mutilation choice.
units.literal: Your servant proposes execution days first proclaim statute—those preferring mutilation lose feet willing death face blade—then hearts submit.

units.zh: 古典刑不上大夫，今士人有犯者，謂宜如舊，不在刑例，則進退為允。」
units.en: In the ancient canon, punishments did not reach grandees. If gentlemen today commit crimes, we think it fitting to follow the old practice and not place them within the penal categories; then either advancing or withdrawing will be appropriate."
units.literal: In the ancient canon, punishments did not reach grandees. If gentlemen today commit crimes, we think it fitting to follow the old practice and not place them within the penal categories; then either advancing or withdrawing will be appropriate."

units.zh: 尚書顗、郎曹彥、中書郎桓彝等議，以為：「復肉刑以代死，誠是聖王之至德，哀矜之弘私。
units.en: Secretary Yi, Gentleman Cao Yan, Palace Writer Gentleman Huan Yi, and others deliberated, saying: "Restoring corporal punishments to replace death truly is the utmost virtue of a sage king and the broad private mercy of pity and compassion.
units.literal: Secretary Yi, Gentleman Cao Yan, Palace Writer Gentleman Huan Yi, and others deliberated, saying: "Restoring corporal punishments to replace death truly is the utmost virtue of a sage king and the broad private mercy of pity and compassion.

units.zh: 然竊以為刑罰輕重，隨時而作。
units.en: Severity must fit era.
units.literal: Yet your servant thinks punishment weight shifts with seasons.

units.zh: 時人少罪而易威，則從輕而寬之；
units.en: When the age produces few crimes and people are easy to overawe, lean toward light and lenient measures.
units.literal: When times produce few crimes easy to awe follow lighter forgiving approach;

units.zh: 時人多罪而難威，則宜化刑而濟之。
units.en: When crime clusters and fear alone cannot awe the populace, toughen and reshape punishments to shore up authority.
units.literal: When times produce many crimes difficult to awe, it is fitting to transform punishments to aid deterrence.

units.zh: 肉刑平世所應立，非救弊之宜也。
units.en: Mutilation fits stability not crisis.
units.literal: Corporal law suits tranquil ages—not remedies for collapse.

units.zh: 方今聖化草創，人有餘奸，習惡之徒，為非未已，截頭絞頸，尚不能禁，而乃更斷足劓鼻，輕其刑罰，使欲為惡者輕犯寬刑，蹈罪更眾，是為輕其刑以誘人於罪，殘其身以加楚酷也。
units.en: Opponents argue wartime Jin cannot soften capital codes without inviting crime.
units.literal: Now sacred transformation sprouts men possess surplus villainy habitual evil ends not though beheading strangling cannot forbid yet cutting feet or noses lightening penalties lets villains casually breach lenient rules crime multiplies—this lightens bait enticing crime tortures bodies adding cruelty.

units.zh: 昔之畏死刑以為善人者，今皆犯輕刑而殘其身，畏重之常人，反為犯輕而致囚，此則何異斷刖常人以為恩仁邪！
units.en: People who once shunned the death penalty as the mark of decency may now break a lighter corporal law and be mutilated, while timid commoners who feared severe penalties end up jailed for slight offenses—how is that any different from hacking the feet off ordinary folk and calling it kindness?
units.literal: Former death-fearing good folk now commit light crimes losing limbs fear-heavy commoners instead commit light offenses entering jail—how differs cutting healthy folk claiming kindness!

units.zh: 受刑者轉廣，而為非者日多，踴貴屨賤，有鼻者醜也。
units.en: Proverb mocks widespread mutilation.
units.literal: Punished multitude grows wrongdoing daily—expensive shoes cheap straw sandals mocked nose-bearing ugliness.

units.zh: 徒有輕刑之名，而實開長惡之源。
units.en: Lenient labels deepen vice.
units.literal: Only light-punishment reputation opens deeper villainy.

units.zh: 不如以殺止殺，重以全輕，權小停之。
units.en: Prefer capital harshness temporarily.
units.literal: Better kill to stop killing weight heavy to guard light pause briefly.

units.zh: 須聖化漸著，兆庶易威之日，徐施行也。」
units.en: We should wait until sagely transformation gradually becomes manifest and the multitude becomes easy to awe, and then put it into effect slowly."
units.literal: We should wait until sagely transformation gradually becomes manifest and the multitude becomes easy to awe, and then put it into effect slowly."

units.zh: 議奏，元帝猶欲從展所上。
units.en: Yuandi leaned toward Wei until blocked.
units.literal: Memorial submitted—Emperor Yuan still wished to follow Wei Zhan’s proposal.

units.zh: 大將軍王敦以為：「百姓習俗日久，忽復肉刑，必駭遠近。
units.en: Great General Wang Dun thought: "The customs of the common people have been practiced for a long time; if corporal punishments are suddenly restored, it will surely frighten people near and far.
units.literal: Great General Wang Dun thought: "The customs of the common people have been practiced for a long time; if corporal punishments are suddenly restored, it will surely frighten people near and far.

units.zh: 且逆寇未殄，不宜有慘酷之聲，以聞天下。」
units.en: Moreover, rebel bandits have not yet been destroyed, and it is not fitting for reports of cruelty and harshness to be heard throughout the realm."
units.literal: Moreover, rebel bandits have not yet been destroyed, and it is not fitting for reports of cruelty and harshness to be heard throughout the realm."

units.zh: 於是乃止。
units.en: Proposal dropped.
units.literal: Therefore it ceased.

units.zh: 咸康之世，庾冰好為糾察，近於繁細，後益矯違，復存寬縱，疏密自由，律令無用矣。
units.en: In the Xiankang era Yu Bing liked to investigate and censure, to the point of pettiness; later he overcorrected and became lenient again, so strictness and laxity followed whim and the statutes were of no use.
units.literal: Xiankang era Yu Bing loved oversight nearing fussiness later correcting violated restoring laxity sparse versus dense self-willed statutes useless.

units.zh: 至安帝元興末，桓玄輔政，又議欲復肉刑斬左右趾之法，以輕死刑，命百官議。
units.en: At the end of Emperor An’s Yuanxing era, regent Huan Xuan again proposed restoring amputation of either foot as a substitute for death and ordered the hundred officials to debate it.
units.literal: By Emperor An’s Yuanxing end Huan Xuan as regent again debated restoring foot-removal lightening capital death ordering hundred offices deliberate.

units.zh: 蔡廓上議曰：「建邦立法，弘教穆化，必隨時置制，德刑兼施。
units.en: Cai Kuo submitted a deliberation, saying: "In establishing a state and setting up laws, broadening instruction and harmonizing transformation, one must establish regulations according to the time and apply virtue and punishment together.
units.literal: Cai Kuo submitted a deliberation, saying: "In establishing a state and setting up laws, broadening instruction and harmonizing transformation, one must establish regulations according to the time and apply virtue and punishment together.

units.zh: 長貞一以閑其邪，教禁以檢其慢，灑湛露以流潤，厲嚴霜以肅威，雖復質文迭用，而斯道莫革。
units.en: Moral education pairs with seasonal punishments.
units.literal: Long rectitude fences evil teachings restrain slack sprinkling sweet dew nourishes harsh frost inspires awe—though substance and culture alternate this path never changes.

units.zh: 肉刑之設，肇自哲王。
units.en: Classical kings instituted mutilation.
units.literal: Corporal punishments stemmed from wise kings.

units.zh: 蓋由曩世風淳，人多惇謹，圖像既陳，則機心直戢，刑人在塗，則不逞改操，故能勝殘去殺，化隆無為。
units.en: Pure ages needed only symbolic deterrence.
units.literal: Because antiquity’s winds pure men mostly honest posted icons checked scheming punished walking roads deterred daring thus overcame cruelty eliminated killing elevated effortless rule.

units.zh: 季末澆偽，設網彌密，利巧之懷日滋，恥畏之情轉寡。
units.en: Decadent ages breed clever crime.
units.literal: Late generations watered deceit denser nets crafty minds grew shame waned.

units.zh: 終身劇役，不足止其奸，況乎黥劓，豈能反於善。
units.en: Modern wickedness ignores corporal shame.
units.literal: Lifetime hard labor cannot stop villainy—how much branding or nose-removal reforms goodness.

units.zh: 徒有酸慘之聲，而無濟俗之益。
units.en: Mutilation noise lacks social uplift.
units.literal: Only sour misery echoes yet benefits customs nothing.

units.zh: 至於棄市之條，實非不赦之罪，事非手殺，考律同歸，輕重均科，減降路塞，鐘陳以之抗言，元皇所為留湣。
units.en: As for the articles on public execution, these are not truly unpardonable crimes; even where no one was killed by hand, the code treats them alike and closes the way to reduction—this is what Zhong Yao and Chen Qun protested, and what Emperor Yuan paused over in pity.
units.literal: As for the marketplace-execution articles, these are not truly unpardonable crimes; even when no one was killed by the offender’s own hand, the code assigns the same penalty and blocks reduction. Zhong Yao and Chen Qun protested this, and Emperor Yuan paused over it in pity.

units.zh: 今英輔翼贊，道邈伊周，誠宜明慎用刑，愛人弘育，申哀矜以革濫，移大辟于支體，全性命之至重，恢繁息於將來。」
units.en: Now outstanding assistants give support and help, and their way is distant as Yi Yin and the Duke of Zhou. Truly they should be clear and cautious in using punishments, love the people and broadly nurture them, extend pity and compassion in order to reform excess, move capital penalties to the limbs, preserve the great weight of life and nature, and restore multiplication and growth for the future."
units.literal: Now outstanding assistants give support and help, and their way is distant as Yi Yin and the Duke of Zhou. Truly they should be clear and cautious in using punishments, love the people and broadly nurture them, extend pity and compassion in order to reform excess, move capital penalties to the limbs, preserve the great weight of life and nature, and restore multiplication and growth for the future."

units.zh: 而孔琳之議不同，用王朗、夏侯玄之旨。
units.en: But Kong Linzhi disagreed, following the views of Wang Lang and Xiahou Xuan.
units.literal: Yet Kong Linzhi disagreed adopting Wang Lang and Xiahou Xuan positions.

units.zh: 時論多與琳之同，故遂不行。
units.en: Majority sided Kong Linzhi—proposal stalled.
units.literal: Contemporary debate mostly agreed with Linzhi therefore not enacted.
